INVOICE No. 2045
Date: July 9
Billed to: Hartman Design Studio

Thank you for your business. This invoice covers the printing of 500 brochures and 200 posters. Payment is [1] within 30 days of the invoice date. [2] A late fee of 2 percent will be added to any balance that remains unpaid after that period. Payments can be made [3] bank transfer or credit card. If you have questions about any charge, please [4] our accounts department at 555-0178.

questions.explanation: 'Payment is due' means it must be paid by that time.

choices: Please make sure that payment reaches us before the due date.
The brochures were designed by a freelance artist.
Our company holiday party will be held in December.
The warehouse is located near the airport.
questions.explanation: The sentence asks for on-time payment and leads into the late fee mentioned next.
'By bank transfer' expresses the means of payment.
One 'contacts' a department to ask questions.

Dear passengers,

Due to severe weather, Flight 218 to Boston has been [1] from 2:15 p.m. to 6:40 p.m. [2] We apologize for the delay and have arranged meal vouchers, which can be collected at Gate 12. Passengers who wish to change their flight will be rebooked [3] charge on the next available departure. Please check the airport's display screens regularly, [4] gate assignments may change without notice.

questions.explanation: 'Rescheduled from one time to another' matches the change of departure time.

choices: The cafeteria will be closed for renovations.
Baggage fees have increased by ten percent.
Our frequent-flyer program has a new logo.
Your new boarding time will be 6:05 p.m.
questions.explanation: The sentence follows the new departure time and gives the consequence for passengers.
'Without charge' means free of charge.
Gate changes are the reason for checking the screens, so a cause connector is needed.

text:
NOTICE: Library Hours

Beginning Monday, September 1, the Eastside Public Library will [1] new opening hours. The library will open at 9 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. on weekdays. [2] On Saturdays, hours will remain from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., and the library will be closed on Sundays. Members who wish to borrow books [3] a valid library card. Overdue items are subject to a fine [4] fifty cents per day.

questions.explanation: 'Adopt new hours' means to start using them; 'adapt' would need 'to'.

choices: The children's section has been painted a new color.
The mayor will give a speech on Friday.
Parking at City Hall is free for residents.
These changes are meant to serve residents who work during the day.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains the reason for the new weekday hours just announced.
A modal verb is followed by the base form.
'A fine of fifty cents' states the amount of the fine.

text:
★★★★☆ Great food, slow service

My colleagues and I had lunch at Casa Verde last Friday, and the food was [1] delicious. The grilled salmon was cooked perfectly, and the vegetables were fresh. [2] We waited nearly forty minutes for our main courses, [3] the restaurant was not especially crowded. The waiter was polite and apologized several times. I would [4] return for the food, but I hope the service improves.

questions.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the adjective 'delicious'.

choices: As a result, we ordered dessert twice.
Therefore, the prices were very reasonable.
In addition, the flight arrived on time.
questions.explanation: The next sentence describes a long wait, which contrasts with the praise for the food.
The long wait is surprising given the restaurant was not crowded: a contrast.
An adverb is needed between the modal 'would' and the verb.

Support Agent (10:02): Thank you for contacting TechAid. How can I help you today?

Support Agent (10:04): I'm sorry to hear that. [2]
Customer (10:06): It says 'offline'. I have already restarted it twice.
Support Agent (10:07): Thanks. Please [3] the printer's network cable and plug it back in. If the problem [4], I will send a technician this afternoon.

questions.explanation: 'Since this morning' requires the present perfect.

choices: Can you tell me what message appears on its display?
We will send you a replacement next week.
Our office is open until 6 p.m.
Thank you for your recent purchase.
questions.explanation: The customer answers with the message shown on the printer, so the agent must have asked about it.

text:
Employee Training Registration – Confirmation

Thank you for registering for the Workplace Safety course. This course is [1] for all new employees and must be completed within their first month. [2] The session will take place in Conference Room B on Wednesday, April 16, from 9 a.m. to noon. Participants are asked to arrive fifteen minutes early [3] they can sign in. Certificates will be issued [4] completion of the course.

questions.explanation: The course 'must be completed', so it is mandatory.

choices: Your vacation request has been denied.
The new parking lot opens next month.
Please submit your tax forms by April 1.
Your place in the next available session has been reserved.
questions.explanation: The sentence confirms the registration and introduces the session details that follow.
'So that' introduces the purpose of arriving early.
'Upon completion' means 'as soon as the course is completed'.

text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: IT Department
Subject: Password policy

Starting next month, all employees will be required to [1] their passwords every 90 days. New passwords must contain at least ten characters, including one number and one symbol. [2] Passwords should never be shared with colleagues or written on paper. The IT Department will send an e-mail reminder [3] days before each password expires. Employees who need assistance [4] visit the help desk on the second floor.

questions.explanation: Passwords are 'changed' regularly.

choices: The cafeteria will serve lunch from noon.
The next staff meeting will be held on Monday.
Parking passes are available at the front desk.
These rules are designed to protect confidential company data.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives the purpose of the policy and leads into the security advice that follows.
'Days' is plural countable, so 'several' is the only possible quantifier.
'Be welcome to + verb' is the fixed expression for an invitation.

text:
